Diego / team —

Attached is a first draft of the phased timeline (Redwood_Cronos_Phase_Timeline_v1.xlsx). Highlights below (high level + canary safeguards):

Phase 0 — Discovery & Test Setup (1 week)
- Deliverables: test account, sample datasets, network details (CIDR, peering window)
- Sanity tests: API auth handshake, basic token exchange, sample inference with 10–50 requests

Phase 1 — Integration & Dry Run (2 weeks)
- App integration: implement client-side retry/backoff, streaming enablement, and KV cache warming plan
- Validation: automated regression suite (50 prompts), avg latency profiling at expected QPS
- Canary prep: define traffic split, metric thresholds (error rate <0.5%, P95 latency <450ms), data capture hooks

Phase 2 — Pilot Canary (2 weeks)
- Pilot size: start with 1% of production traffic for 48 hours, move to 5% for 72 hours, then 20% for 5 days if gates pass
- Gates: zero data exfiltration incidents, error rate stable within threshold, qualitative QA pass on 200 seed prompts
- Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >1% for 30+ minutes OR systemic degradation in P90/P95 latency by >25% vs baseline

Phase 3 — Gradual Ramp & Cutover (1 week ramp, 2 weeks observation)
- Ramp steps: 20% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% each step 24–48 hours with automated health checks
- Cutover window: prefer 2–4 hour low-traffic window with DB snapshots and reversible routing rules

Phase 4 — Post-Cutover Monitoring & Hypercare (2 weeks)
- Active monitoring: token-level cost sampling, per-route error tracing, daily syncs for the first week, weekly for the second
- Metrics: latency, error, token usage, cache hit rate, and model regression checks against baseline prompts

Additional notes:
- Data migration: Cronos indicated limited historical replays; propose ingestion-only approach with validation on sample subsets.
- Runbook snippets: included in the XLS (service restart, kv-cache flush, fallback to smaller model variant).
- Dependencies: VPC peering, service account with KMS unwrap permission, test data CSV (12k rows).

I'll iterate if Rishi flags security constraints.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
